description: technical-team hooks: the guard (PreToolUse) enforces write ownership, per-role shell policy, lead-only delegation, the hire approval gate (a new HIRE-APPROVED line in .team/STATE.md always raises a permission prompt) and per-role skill lists; the handoff check (SubagentStop) sends a team agent back when it ends without the handoff block (or the lead without its report). Calls from your own main session are otherwise not affected.
